launch.name: Personal Warp
launch.summary: Single Warp session for personal-side work on screen 2, replacing the two Claude terminals. Each plain warp.exe launch opens a new window; `cwd` opens it in the personal workspace root (title 'pwsh in rig'). Warp can't auto-run a command on Windows, so run `claude` yourself.

launch.name: Personal Browser
launch.summary: Opens Chrome with the Profile 1 personal profile. Shares {chrome-user-data} with the Admin desktop's Profile 4 windows, so the launched PID hands off to the existing browser process and every Chrome window looks identical to `window_process_name` alone. `--new-window` forces a window to actually appear instead of focusing an existing Profile 1 one, and `window_title` pins the match to the personal Gmail window - without both, restore binds to whatever chrome.exe window shows up next and has previously grabbed work-profile windows.

launch.name: VS Code (rig)
launch.summary: Opens the rig repo folder in its own VS Code window. Deliberately opens the folder rather than rig.code-workspace: the Review desktop owns that multi-root workspace file, and VS Code focuses the already-open workspace window instead of opening a second one, so two desktops opening the same .code-workspace collide onto one window. A plain folder window is a distinct VS Code window.
